title: Devyce is landing in Australia this November!
summary: Devyce’s worst kept secret is finally out in the open. We are launching our APAC office in Melbourne, Australia
body_markdown:
Devyce’s worst kept secret is finally out in the open. We are launching our APAC office in Melbourne, Australia 🇦🇺


With a growing Australian client base, it's time to put boots on the ground!


Having a team based in our new Melbourne office means:


- Local support, in your time zone


- Closer collaboration and faster feedback


- More opportunities to connect face-to-face


‍


And for those we've yet to meet? We're bringing smarter, simpler telephony that cuts admin, boosts productivity and gives recruiters more time to make placements.


And we're not arriving quietly…


We've got a busy events calendar ahead, so plenty of opportunities to meet the team and see what Devyce can do for your business.


‍[Amirah](https://www.linkedin.com/in/amirah-miller-19195525a/) will be making the move on shore alongside[Olivia](https://www.linkedin.com/in/olivia-irving/) from next month, with lots of exciting events coming up soon. Watch this space 👀


‍


We sat down with[Nick](https://www.linkedin.com/in/nick-browne-a8a829147/) and[Amirah](https://www.linkedin.com/in/amirah-miller-19195525a/) to find out more about the expansion into the market👇
